title: Number Link Flow
instructions: Connect pairs of matching numbers of the same color to fill the entire grid without crossing paths.
description: Number Link Flow is a sleek and challenging logic puzzle game. Connect matching colored number nodes by drawing continuous pipes. Fill 100% of the grid to achieve flow without intersecting lines across 30+ handcrafted levels from 5x5 Beginner to 9x9 Master packs.

faqs.q: How do you play Number Link Flow?
faqs.a: Touch and drag from any numbered circle to connect it with its matching colored number. Fill all empty squares in the grid to win.
No, pipes cannot overlap or cross each other. Drawing over an existing pipe will disconnect or shorten it.

faqs.q: Does the game work on mobile devices?
faqs.a: Yes, Number Link Flow is fully responsive and optimized for touch screens on smartphones, tablets, and computers.
